title: slice claim carries untracked lead task records
body:
Outcome: `krn slice run` claim works for a task whose record exists only untracked in the main checkout: it copies lead-owned untracked `tasks/<id>.json` records of this lane into the new worktree and commits them as a tracker commit, or refuses with the exact command to do so.
Evidence: #210 claim exited 65 "tasks/t-3ny1bcp.json: task does not exist"; the lead moved four records into the worktree and committed b3c87ff by hand.
Proof: an observer creates a task untracked in the main checkout, runs slice run --stop-after claim, and expects exit 0 with the record committed in the worktree.
